body_revisions.scope: Count actual target-model forward rows by verification batch and connect rejected rows to the next committed output.
body_revisions.observation: The early-mismatch case reduces calls from 6 to 5 but increases post-prompt forward rows from 5 to 8. All three cases retain the same client sequence.
